reviewHistory.rejected: Early imports were rejected for invisible or severely stretched deformation; their evidence frames and packages v1-v3 were removed from the active project set.
reviewHistory.rootCause: The original FBX pipeline produced a 10000x shared Skeleton Root scale; bounded local rotations therefore amplified skinned deformation.
reviewHistory.acceptedCorrection: Export armature objects at identity scale with FBX global scale 100, bind to the corrected shared Skeleton, remove the animation Root track and normalize all child translation/scale channels to the Skeleton reference pose.
reviewHistory.reviewBoundary: Agent-observed technical body-performance acceptance only; human physical-display and animation/cultural review remain open.
